items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee only responds to the interviewer's references to Stanley Dance's book and quotes; there is no evidence of a personal relationship or direct interaction between Lawrence Brown and Stanley Dance.

ctx.x: Tate's. Are you -- no, I guess it was Stanley Dance says that Duke says he named "Slippery Horn" because the title was inspired by your playing. Did he tell you that?
No. I never heard that. "Slippery Horn" uh-huh.
